verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a compliance SaaS could offer a natural-language interface for operating its features, but the pack shows no way to run the product by natural-language commands. Compliance Navigator AI™ is documented only as delivering regulatory guidance, not as executing actions like filings or registration updates, so it is an adjacent feature. The llms.txt and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks an agent could use, not a natural-language operation capability, so they earn no credit.
